description: This file defines the base class for media playback task tests in a GStreamer-based media pipeline. It includes setup routines for video and audio elements, callback handling, and task execution methods for testing media setup, geometry, volume, and source attachment.

classes.name: TasksTestsBase
classes.description: A base class providing common setup, expectations, and trigger methods for testing media tasks involving GStreamer elements, callbacks, and pipeline configuration.

methods.name: TasksTestsBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing test context, GStreamer, and pipeline setup.

methods.name: ~TasksTestsBase
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up GStreamer objects and resetting test context.

methods.name: expectSetupVideoElement
methods.description: Sets expectations for configuring a video element, including factory and signal handling.

methods.name: expectSetupAudioElement
methods.description: Sets expectations for configuring an audio element, including factory and signal handling.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementOnly
methods.description: Configures expectations for setting up a generic video element without specific sink types.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementWesterossink
methods.description: Configures expectations for setting up a Westerossink video element with rectangle geometry.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementAmlhalasink
methods.description: Configures expectations for setting up an Amlhalasink video element with specific properties.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementPendingGeometryNonWesterissink
methods.description: Configures expectations for setting up a video element with pending geometry when not using Westerossink.

methods.name: shouldSetupAudioElementOnly
methods.description: Configures expectations for setting up only an audio element.

methods.name: shouldSetVideoUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Prepares expectation for setting a video underflow callback.

methods.name: triggerVideoUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Simulates invocation of the video underflow callback.

methods.name: shouldSetAudioUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Prepares expectation for setting an audio underflow callback.

methods.name: triggerAudioUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Simulates invocation of the audio underflow callback.

methods.name: triggerSetupElement
methods.description: Executes the setup element task.

methods.name: setPipelineToNull
methods.description: Sets the pipeline reference in the test context to null.

methods.name: triggerSetVideoGeometryFailure
methods.description: Executes a set video geometry task expecting failure, verifying pending geometry remains unchanged.

methods.name: shouldSetVideoGeometry
methods.description: Sets expectation for setting the video rectangle.

methods.name: triggerSetVideoGeometrySuccess
methods.description: Executes a set video geometry task expecting success and updates pending geometry.

methods.name: setAllSourcesAttached
methods.description: Marks all sources as attached in the test context.

methods.name: shouldScheduleAllSourcesAttached
methods.description: Sets expectation for scheduling sources attached.

methods.name: triggerSetupSource
methods.description: Executes the setup source task and verifies source assignment.

methods.name: shouldSetGstVolume
methods.description: Sets expectation for setting the GStreamer stream volume.

methods.name: triggerSetVolume
methods.description: Executes the set volume task.
